```yaml
name: ci-lazer-sui-contract

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'lazer/contracts/sui/**'
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'lazer/contracts/sui/**'

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Sui CLI (v0.9.0)
        run: |
          # Download the Sui CLI binary for Linux
          curl -L https://github.com/MystenLabs/sui/releases/download/v0.9.0/sui-linux-amd64 -o sui
          chmod +x sui
          sudo mv sui /usr/local/bin/
          # Verify installation
          sui --version

      - name: Run Sui Move tests
        working-directory: lazer/contracts/sui
        run: |
          sui move test
```
